title: A Room for the Winter
author: Ada Zhou
blurb: Coral Ravensworth, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
